---
title: "4 Adv Spatial Viz"
---


## 🧩 Learning Goals

By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:

- Understand the basics of a CRS (coordinate reference system)
- Understand and recognize different spatial file types and data types in R
- Implement some of the basic plotting with the `sf` package
- Understand foundation ideas in working with spatial data (aggregating spatial point data to a spatial region, joining spatial data sets)



## Setup

For this activity, create the following directory structure in your portfolio repository under `ica` folder:


```markdown
portfolio
 └─ ica
    └─ 04_adv_maps
       ├─ code
       │  └─ 04-adv-maps-1-notes.qmd ← the downloaded ICA Template
       ├─ data
       │  └─ ...  ← saving data here during this activity
       └─ figures
          └─ ...  ← saving created maps here during this activity
```
